bracket: [Textbook answer-key error: the printed key gives \(x = 4\). Subtracting 4 leaves 8, 12, 17, and \(12^2 = 144\) while \(8 \times 17 = 136\) — not a continued proportion. Solving \((16 - x)^2 = (12 - x)(21 - x)\) gives \(256 - 32x = 252 - 33x\), i.e. \(x = -4\); subtracting \(-4\) leaves 16, 20, 25 and \(20^2 = 400 = 16 \times 25\). The key has dropped the minus sign — note the chapter's own worked example of exactly this type (subtracting from 7, 12, 18) correctly yields the negative value \(-18\).]
